summary: Iteration 7: Validated the brand-new Ecommerce (Penjualan Online) feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_ecommerce.py covering create (field computation + stock decrement), invalid channel 400, empty items 400, listing (incl. channel filter), reports (harian/bulanan/tahunan with structure assertions, channel_names == 4 channels), RBAC (kasir can create but cannot delete -> 403), and admin delete restores stock. Frontend: Playwright flow logged in as Admin, selected Tokopedia channel, added a product, set harga=25000 + admin_fee=1000 + ongkir=9000 + biaya_lain=500, and verified Est. diterima rendered as Rp 14.500 (25000-10500) matching backend formula. Simpan Penjualan succeeded with success toast, new row appeared in 'Penjualan Online Terbaru', admin sees ecom-delete-{id} buttons. Laporan Online (/laporan/online) loads summary cards (Total Omzet Rp 230.000, Biaya Rp 55.000, Laba Kotor Rp 160.000, Laba Bersih Rp 105.000), per-channel comparison bar chart, trend chart, and breakdown table with TOTAL row across all 3 modes (harian/bulanan/tahunan). Kasir login confirmed: on /penjualan-online no ecom-delete-* buttons rendered (admin-only). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now at 905 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold where splitting into feature modules (ecommerce.py, reports.py, pos.py) would improve maintainability.

ecom create_ecom_sale decrements stock via $inc without validating that resulting stok >= 0 or checking current stok; a POST with qty > available stok would create a sale and push stok negative silently (frontend prevents it, but API has no server-side guard). Consider adding a pre-check mirroring POS logic.
gen_ecom_no() uses count_documents (not per-day) so ECOM number resets never happen; two sales deleted + new one could collide. Minor, non-blocking.
ecom_reports regex uses re.escape(prefix) over created_at (ISO string). Works, but a $gte/$lt range query on an indexed field would scale better than regex scan.
